title: Slowing Down Light
content: In case you missed it, here's a remarkable video showing a the results of a virtual camera developed at MIT that can "slow down" the movement of photons of light by synchronizing laser pulses with the sensor array.This first video shows the results, as light slowly transits across a still life with a tomato (Video link).This video explains the equipment and method (Video Link)---Thanks to several people who mentioned this to me.
